provenance.description: Corrected oracle rolled forward by the 2026-10 food-balance corrections (docs/integration/food-balance-2026-10.md). Captured with the exact capture loops of tests/test_performance_equivalence.py and tests/test_governance_dormancy.py in Python off mode with the native ecology/politics runtimes disabled. Corrections are listed in commit order; each workload index is the first turn that correction changes relative to the oracle with all earlier corrections applied (consecutive captures of the branch commits). The corrected_extinction_2026_10 (and older) fixtures remain frozen; workloads not named in 'corrections' would be byte-identical to them.

corrections.summary: Aggregate overflow migration (climate.process_migration) is a no-op when the agent pool owns population (hybrid, demographics-only).
corrections.note: Off-mode workloads are unchanged; the correction is confined to agent-owned modes.

corrections.summary: Soil degrades when population exceeds potential capacity (carrying capacity x capacity modifier), not the degraded effective capacity.
Temperate water recovery is the climatic rate, no longer scaled by the population pressure multiplier (controlled and uncontrolled regions).
MINES are a valid build only in regions with an ORE or PRECIOUS resource slot.
Travelling (Loading/Transit) merchants count in their trip origin's occupational supply and population (native behavior and satisfaction inputs).
corrections.note: Native agent runtime only; the off-mode oracle lane does not run it.

corrections.summary: A merchant that delivers returns to its trip origin after the arrival turn's knowledge phase instead of settling at the destination.
corrections.note: Native agent runtime only; the off-mode oracle lane does not run it.

corrections.summary: Native fertility crowding brake tapers from 0.75x and stops at 1.0x capacity (was 1.0x to 1.6x).
corrections.note: Native agent runtime only; the off-mode oracle lane does not run it.

corrections.summary: The goods economy reads goods per farmer (realized harvest index / its long-run healthy-land normal) instead of the raw M34 harvest index; fishery catch budgets and the fishery labour split use the same units.
corrections.note: No golden workload changes: the exact-trajectory off-mode lane does not read the converted economy yields for any of its outcomes.

corrections.summary: An outbreak's cross-civ contagion spreads at most PLAGUE_CONTACT_WEIGHT_REF (3.0) of contact weight; a civ with more contact divides it in proportion.

provenance.comparison: complete emitted file set, byte count and SHA256; no field filtering or tolerance
